name: Mecha HUD
author: sazardev
description: Flat Mecha Green system monitor for Omarchy: ping, CPU, RAM, battery, status, radar and live wallpaper controls.

barWidget.description: A clean military-green monitor with NET latency, CPU load, RAM pressure, system status, radar and live wallpaper controls.

schema.label: Ping host
schema.description: Host or IP used for the NET latency readout.

schema.label: Ping interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the NET readout sends one ICMP echo request.

schema.label: Show PWR
schema.description: Display the battery readout when a battery is present.
